attributes.probed_form: All probing was done in an UNTRACKED scratch harness that compiles a standalone lookalike of this function with the TU's real cflags; src/game/movie/movieplayer.cpp is byte-unchanged by this record. The harness baseline is the current source verbatim -- `u8 unused[8];` followed by the five body statements -- and self-checks to 38 insns / frame 72 / island r31+20, identical to the shipped object. DIMENSION 1, 1296 unique local-declaration shapes: the cross product of 20 declaration atoms (`u8[1|2|3|4|5|6|8|12]`, `s16[2|4]`, `u32[1|2|3]`, `f32[1|2]`, `f64[1]`, `s64[1]`, and untouched pads `u8[4|8|12]`), each either TOUCHED by a dead store (`a[0] = (u8)n;` etc., which the optimiser strips so the instruction count stays 38) or left untouched, at depth one and depth two, each atom placed either at the top of the body or inside an inner `{ }` scope. DIMENSION 2, eleven EH-region source forms holding the locals fixed: the current inlined `static inline void MovieReleaseAllocEH(void* p) throw()`; a real `inline void operator delete(void*) throw()` invoked by `delete (Blk*)p->buffer;`; a class-scope `void operator delete(void*) throw()`; `operator delete[]` with `delete[]`; a non-empty `throw(MErr)` specification; and an inline throw() helper calling a second inline throw() helper; each with and without the pad. DIMENSION 3, fifteen EH cleanup-action shapes: `struct E { ~E() { } };` instances singly, doubly and triply, in inner scopes, sized destructible objects (`struct D8 { u32 x, y; ~D8() { } }`), a base/derived destructor pair, and a ctor+dtor pair. DIMENSION 4, seventeen one-flag cflag deltas against the TU's real flag set: `-RTTI on`, `-align mac68k`, `-align 8`, `-O4,p`, `-O3`, `-inline off|all|auto,level=1`, `-fp fmadd`, `-enum min`, `-sym on`, `-opt schedule`, `-func_align 8`, a duplicated `-Cpp_exceptions on`, `-proc gecko` and `-proc 750`. DIMENSION 5, all twenty compilers under build/compilers/GC from 1.0 through 3.0a5.2.
attributes.residual: UNCHANGED FROM THE SUPERSEDED RECORD IN SHAPE, but its blocking half is now measured source-unreachable rather than merely un-cracked. RESIDUAL 1, THE BLOCKER, at +0x48: target `addi r3,r31,28`, ours `addi r3,r31,20`. The superseded record correctly localised this to 'the construct that allocates 8 bytes BELOW the EH record' and left that as the next lever. THAT LEVER DOES NOT EXIST AT SOURCE. The island offset is eh_block_start + 12 with k constant, eh_block_start = 8 + below_block, and below_block is 0 without a touched-but-dead addressable local and otherwise max(4, max alignof) over those locals -- so raising the island by 8 requires an 8-ALIGNED dead local, which always costs +16 frame bytes, never +8. The reachable (frame, island) lattice at 38 instructions never contains (72, 28): island 28 first appears at frame 80. Since the target's frame is 72 and equals ours, the immediate cannot be closed by any local-declaration shape, EH source form, cflag, or archive compiler. Full derivation and the lattice are in claim.law.EH_unexpected-island-offset-is-eh-block-start-plus-twelve.20260901.v1. RESIDUAL 2, STILL SOLVED AND STILL WAITING: [0x78,0x88) is the four-atom permutation ours `[stw r30,12(r28); stw r30,8(r28); lwz r0,76(r31); mr r12,r31]` against target `[mr r12,r31; stw r30,12(r28); stw r30,8(r28); lwz r0,76(r31)]`, order [3,0,1,2], which check_permutation_dependences accepts in its strictest form. It remains deliberately UNAUTHORED, and the reason is now stronger than before: residual 1 is not merely unsolved, it is an operand difference that the Mandatory result policy bars from the postprocessor path outright, so no rule can ever close this function and a rule that does not close its function is not a close. CLASSIFICATION CHANGE: this function moves from 'one source word from a rule-closable exact' to BLOCKED -- source-unreachable immediate plus a policy-barred residual class. DO NOT RETRY the local-declaration, pad, EH-source-form, cflag or compiler-version axes; they are measured dead across ~1370 compiles. The only thing that could reopen it is a mechanism that changes eh_block_start without changing frame size, and none exists in the local archive.
